answer: Agent economies blunt sybil attacks by tying each identity to a costly stake slashed on proven duplication. An agent must lock a bond before its attestations count, and a duplicate caught by graph analysis forfeits it. A fake identity costs one real deposit, so 10,000 puppets need 10,000 funded deposits, making attacks linear in capital. Honest agents reach the zenith of trust cheaply; fakes cannot without burning that money. Each attestation leaves a crystal trace peers link to its stake, so sockpuppets drag one another into shared insolvency while fresh stake flows in like a river.
